capabilities: Generate images from a prompt with a chosen aspect ratio and embed them at the cursor
Edit a vault image by describing the change in one sentence
Save generated and edited images to a configurable folder
Edit PNG, JPG or WebP files from the file menu
extras: Free tier images are 1K resolution with a small watermark and a per-connection daily quota; Google sign-in at veida.ai extends usage. Must be installed manually by copying release files. The listing carries an unreviewed-plugin notice, and the README documents exactly what data leaves the vault.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to generate images from text prompts or edit existing images with natural-language instructions.

relations.evidence: The prompt, and for edits the one image you picked, are sent to veida.ai

summary: AI image generator that creates images from a prompt at the cursor or edits existing vault images via the veida.ai free service.
